title: Iki setup input (iki/v1)
description: What iki-worker gets when it leases an environment's setup build (ADR 0075): the script to run, the volumes it fills (each already mounted, writable, where the environment says), and the lease it holds. The script writes its volumes; it may write `{"data_version": "…"}` to IKI_OUTPUT to say what the data is.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this document follows.

setup.description: The setup build: which, the version it makes, and the environment and plugin it's for.

version.description: The version of the environment's volumes it makes.

environment.description: The plugin and the environment, such as `iki/protein.structure-tools`.

plugin.description: The plugin the environment is from, at the version installed when the build was asked for.

sha.description: The plugin's commit, when the deployment was built from a lockfile.

job.description: For iki-worker: the lease it holds, and its limits.

id.description: The ID the worker API names the build by: the same as `setup.id`.

lease_token.description: What the worker gives with every report on the build, to show it holds the lease. Each lease has a new one.

lease_expires_at.description: When the lease ends unless the worker renews it, in UTC.

proxy.description: For a setup that declares hosts under `setup.network`: the egress proxy, with this build's credentials. The worker gives it to the script as HTTPS_PROXY.

script.description: The setup script, a path in the plugin. The worker runs it with `sh`.

volumes.description: The volumes the script fills, by name.

mount.description: Where it's mounted, writable: an absolute path.

settings.description: The deployment's values for the plugin's settings, as its runs get them.
